charge_port.notes: Estimated: 2025 Q6/A6 are CCS1 (Audi EVs lack a NACS port, 2025-09-08); no source for MY2027 shows a native NACS inlet (Wards/InsideEVs/electrive 2027 pages do not mention it).

supercharger_access.notes: InsideEVs/electrive 2025-09-08: Q6 e-tron and A6 e-tron gain Supercharger access (US and Canada same date) with the Audi NACS DC adapter, included with new 2025 Q6/A6 Sportback/GT purchases.
